_comment: Isotropic parameters used in the thesis. lambda, mu in GPa, rho in kg/m^3. Velocities follow from V_T=sqrt(mu/rho), V_L=sqrt((lambda+2mu)/rho). Densities are standard bulk values (not given in the source tables) -- confirm before publishing.
